notable_absence.finding: This page's 'Configuring Threshold Logging' section reproduces a JSON entry format (total_duration_us, encode_duration_us, last_dispatch_duration_us, total_dispatch_duration_us, last_server_duration_us, operation_name, last_local_id, operation_id, last_local_socket, last_remote_socket) that is textually near-identical to observability-orphan-logger.md's 'Experimental JSON Output Format Descriptions' table for its new orphan-log format - but this page never states that it is describing the SAME experimental format rather than a similar-but-separate one for threshold logging, so no isSynonymOf relation could be safely extracted despite the two being, on inspection, near-identical field-for-field.
